home.heroTitulo: Quote like a big company, without stopping being you
home.heroSubtitulo: Quotes, invoices, receipts and non-disclosure agreements. With your logo, signed by you, in a link your client opens on their phone and accepts with one tap. All from your phone, in minutes.
home.promoLibre: Free with every feature until {{fecha}} · no card needed
home.promoPrueba: {{promo}} free with everything unlocked · then USD 2/month · cancel anytime

completo.desc: Items, quantities, per-line discounts, taxes, deposit and currency. Totals add themselves up.

marca.desc: Your logo, your colors and your contact details on the PDF and everywhere your client looks. Their logo too, right beside their details.

enlace.desc: Send a link over WhatsApp or a QR code: they open it on their phone and accept with one tap, nothing to print.

avisos.titulo: You know the moment they open it
avisos.desc: Seen, accepted or declined, with the date. And the alert reaches you while the app is open.

rubro.desc: Pick your line of work and your first quote is born with the terms, payment methods and validity your trade actually uses.

pdfPropio.desc: If you design it yourself —like photographers do, with the shots and packages already laid out— upload it and it travels with the quote.

facturas.desc: An accepted quote turns into an invoice in one tap. And every payment or deposit gets its receipt.

confidencialidad.desc: Draft the agreement, send it as a link and they sign from their phone. It keeps the date, the time and a digital fingerprint of the signed text.

firma.titulo: Your signature, once and for all
firma.desc: Draw it on screen with your finger or upload a photo of it on paper. From then on your quotes and agreements come out already signed.

clientes.desc: Your clients and your prices stay saved. The next quote takes two taps.

reportes.titulo: What you close and what you don't
reportes.desc: Reports show you what was accepted, what was declined and what's still waiting for an answer.

invitar.desc: Pass your link to someone else who bills on their own and you both walk away with free time.

home.cierre: Everything works the same on your computer and on your phone, in Spanish or in English: pick it up top and the whole app follows you.

seo.descripcionPorDefecto: Build polished quotes and send them as a PDF over WhatsApp or email. Clients, items, terms and accepted-quote tracking, all in one app. Try it free.
seo.ingresarDesc: Sign in to your Numera account to see and build your quotes.
seo.recuperarDesc: We'll email you a link to get back into your Numera account.
seo.nuevaPasswordDesc: Choose a new password for your Numera account.

firma.descConFirma: Your new quotes and agreements already come out signed by you.
firma.descSinFirma: Save it once and never draw it again.
firma.explicacion: Sign right here with your finger, or sign a sheet of white paper with a black pen, take a straight photo and upload it: the app strips the paper away and keeps only the stroke.
firma.subirFoto: Upload a photo of my signature
firma.reemplaza: Saving replaces the one you had.
firma.confirmarBorrado: Delete your saved signature? Agreements already signed are left alone.
firma.avisoPublic: It's saved in your account now. If the signature is still in public/, delete that file from the project: anyone who knows the address can download it there.
firma.lienzoNota: It's saved exactly as you drew it.
firma.errorNoEsImagen: The file {{archivo}} is not an image.

registro.invitacion: 🎁 You came in through an invitation. Create your account and whoever sent it gets credit for one referral.
registro.rubroAyuda: With this, your quotes start out with the terms and payment methods typical of your trade. You can change them whenever you want.
registro.confirmaSubtitulo: We sent you a link to confirm your account.
registro.seoDesc: Create your Numera account and build your first quote in minutes. Free, no card needed.

clientes.logoAyuda: Optional. Only if that client has a logo of their own.

perfil.bajada: These details appear on every quote you share.
perfil.logoAyuda: PNG or JPG, transparent background recommended.
perfil.tuNombreAyuda: This is the name printed under your signature on the quote. "Martinez Studio" does not sign anything: a person does.
perfil.tuCargoEjemplo: e.g. CEO and Developer at sTuDiob2b
perfil.tuCargoAyuda: It goes under your name, on your signature line. The client's line stays empty: they write that themselves.
perfil.contactoRedesAyuda: Whatever you add here shows up on the PDF and on the link your client opens, with its icon and one tap away on a phone. All optional: anything left empty is not shown.
perfil.noSeEntiende: That can't be read and won't be shown.
perfil.rubroAyuda: Only used to suggest the texts below when you leave them empty. It changes nothing you already saved.
perfil.formasPagoEjemplo: e.g. Bank transfer, cash, Mercado Pago.
perfil.datosBancarios: Bank details / alias (they appear on the PDF)
perfil.terminosEjemplo:
e.g. The warranty covers 6 months against manufacturing defects.
Cancellations with less than 48 hours notice do not refund the deposit.
Delivery times may vary due to supplier delays.
perfil.terminosAyuda: Your business's legal text (warranty, cancellations, fine print). It is printed at the end of the PDF and of the public link of all your documents. Leave it empty and nothing appears.
perfil.marcaPremiumDetalle: Your own color, a numbering prefix and hiding "Made with Numera". Premium feature.
perfil.firmaFueraForm: Deliberately outside the form: the signature saves itself as soon as you upload it.
